A photo of the machine and any error code would help. We'll update you by 30 July.

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've put your request to them, including that the new machine would stay yours and go with you when you leave. We've also asked who covers removing the old one and fitting the new one, and what happens to the existing machine. Please don't remove or buy anything until we confirm. A photo of the machine and any error code would help. We'll update you by 30 July.
